study_scope: Retrospective P0 sufficient certificates on the frozen tetrahedron; preliminary budget behavior is known. No blind evaluation or general region enumeration.
point_definition: Exact centroid of the four decoded nm rational vertices; expected strict-free. Does not prove enclosure or an exhaustive region count.
path_definition: Four segments from the exact centroid to the exact centroid of each opposite face; expected strict all-atom clearance inside the declared tetrahedron. Does not prove the boundary patch inventory.
bounds_contract: Exact lower/upper probe-center volume enclosures in nm**3; no requested precision is claimed.
topology_scope: Only full-domain exclusion or full-free convex-domain certificates give complete counts. Positive point/path controls leave general topology not computed.
